187 monsters after the latest fossil + mythic batch.
Move counts are weighted approximately toward the roster's observed type mix, not evenly split across 18 types.
PP and base-power bands are tuned in the spirit of FireRed-era pacing: common moves have more PP; high-power/signature moves have less.
A dash (—) means the move deals no direct damage.
Percentages are proc chances unless the text says the effect is guaranteed.
General = broadly teachable/learnable. A named monster indicates a bespoke signature-style move designed around that line.
Accuracy, physical/special category, priority, targeting, learnsets, TMs/tutors, and level-up acquisition can be layered onto this catalogue without changing the 354-move cap.
